thread:
maria-sales: Kicked off a POC with ElmBank this morning. They're evaluating switching off VendorX and want endpoint-level parity for their payments assistant. Looking for checklist items and acceptance criteria.

devon-se: Nice. Main asks from ElmBank: identical prompt results for 95% of queries, header mapping for auth, same rate-limit semantics, and no unexpected token accounting changes.

eli-customer: Quick context from our side: we use /v1/generate with a bunch of pre-prompts and a custom stop sequence. Billing is monthly at token+request tiers. We'll need an apples-to-apples cost projection.

sam-ml: For prompt parity we should collect a representative prompt set (1000 short + 200 long), and run A/B on both runtimes. We'll capture token counts and exact output diffs.

maria-sales: Can we get a staging sandbox with our mapping? ElmBank needs SSO and allowlisting of outbound IPs (they're on strict firewall).

deploy-bot: sandbox-elmbank created in us-east-1. IPs: 54.210.33.12, 54.210.33.13. KMS key placeholder: projects/redwood/keys/elmbank-sandbox-key.

nora-security: We'll need to complete ElmBank's security questionnaire. Highlights: KMS HSM requirement, support for customer-managed keys, audit log retention, and SOC2 artifacts. I can own the Qs.

eli-customer: Also need SSO (SAML) and SCIM for user provisioning for their SREs.

devon-se: For the API surface mapping, here's a quick shim snippet we used for an earlier POC:

```
# map VendorX -> Redwood
curl -X POST https://sandbox.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "X-Client-Request-Id: $REQ_ID" \
  -d '{"prompt":"<original prompt>","max_tokens":256,"stop":["\nEND"]}'
```

Note: we expose `x-client-request-id` for idempotency mapping; ElmBank uses `request-id` header today.

sam-ml: Important: VendorX uses a different tokenization baseline which can cause off-by-1s in token billing. We should run a token equivalence check to compute billing delta and include quantization/temperature parity tests.

maria-sales: Pricing question from ElmBank: if their monthly token consumption is 150M tokens, what delta to expect if we match behavior vs optimize batching/quantization? Need a clear table.

devon-se: I'll run a cost sim: baseline (drop-in parity) vs optimized (batching + 8-bit quant) and share numbers by EOD tomorrow.

nora-security: On data residency: ElmBank asked about EU region for production. We can offer dedicated capacity in eu-west-1 and provide a data flow diagram and retention settings. I'll attach SOC2 section and KMS notes to questionnaire.

eli-customer: Acceptance criteria from procurement: 1) 95% parity on intent for the prompt set, 2) latency within 20% of VendorX under 95th percentile, 3) SSO + KMS validated, 4) clear cost delta.

maria-sales: Good summary. Also need rollback plan and canary gates for their cutover window.

devon-se: Proposed rollout: stage->canary (10% traffic, 48h)->expand with automatic fallback on error rate >0.5% or latency >2x. We'll add a script to toggle routing.

sam-ml: For the evaluation harness, please send S3 link to the prompt set and expected annotations. We'll produce a diff report with examples of regressions and suggested prompt shim rules.

eli-customer: Uploading vectors now to s3://elmbank-poc/prompts/2026-03-22. Credentials posted to shared vault.

nora-security: Two blockers to call out: ElmBank legal requires a breach notification SLA 24h and we need to confirm support for their KMS vendor (Thales) in private deployment.

maria-sales: Noted. I will escalate contract note for 24h notification to legal. Devon, can you confirm Thales KMS integration feasibility?

devon-se: Thales is supported in our Private offering; for Dedicated we can wire customer-managed keys via our KMS bridge but may need a short integration window (~2 weeks). I'll spin up a task.

eli-customer: One more: rate-limit semantics — VendorX allows burst of 300rps with token bucket. ElmBank expects identical behavior to avoid latency spikes in their gateway.

devon-se: We'll replicate token-bucket burst behavior at the ingress layer. Will add acceptance smoke tests for bursts.

maria-sales: Thanks everyone. Action items: devon run cost sim + burst smoke tests; sam prepare diff report; nora finish questionnaire + SOC2 artifacts; I will sync with legal on breach SLA and confirm go/no-go timeline (target decision in 2 weeks). :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: task created: POC-ELMBANK-1234 (owner: devon-se)

eli-customer: Appreciated — ElmBank team will be available for a live call Thursday 10am PT to walk through the prompt set and early diffs.

maria-sales: I'll book the meeting and share dial-in.

sam-ml: I'll be there to walk the diff report.

nora-security: I'll join for the questionnaire review.

maria-sales: Closing note — keep thread for questions only, meeting notes will go to the calendar invite.

eli-customer: Sounds good, thanks all.
